name: Nitou Kanami
source:
School: 1st-year Moriyoh Gakuen
Description: she is a typical ko-gal
Profile: At first appearance, she doesn't look like a normal school student. She emphasizes on style and always dress according to the latest trends. Her looks and her charming attitude attract a lot of attention from the opposite sex.  She's looking for a boyfriend and she's very wide open in her choices of topics.
